interpretation.confirmed: The placeholder-merge mechanism itself works exactly as designed at the TerminologyManager.protect() layer (verified directly, single anchor).
interpretation.unverified_and_concerning: End-to-end, the professionalize_llm model still translated straight through the (now single) placeholder for this highly-repeated, salient phrase, rather than preserving it verbatim -- restore() only fixes recognizable corruptions of an intact placeholder token (case/spacing/script), not a case where the model fully replaces the placeholder with real target-language words it 'knows' from repeated exposure elsewhere in the same document. If that is what happened, no config-level protection change can fix it; it needs either a stronger placeholder format/prompt instruction, or acceptance that this specific compound cannot be frozen this way.
interpretation.confound_not_ruled_out: The debug harness runs a single isolated locale call, not a full campaign batch -- the sibling control's own inconsistency with 6-day-old evidence (GitHub-first vs repository-first) means generation conditions are not proven identical to a real campaign run, so this single data point is suggestive, not conclusive. A proper verdict needs the real campaign context once QU-02 can legitimately be lifted for this class, or several more debug-harness samples across locales/models to see if the pattern is consistent.
